contract: scripts/reward10/contract.py (module shape, trainer API); generated, do not edit by hand

shared.start_select: blocked after boot unless the game lists them (pausing before a death dodges the death penalty)

win_status.verified: seen in a genuine run in this emulator
win_status.provisional: detector seen only with help (RAM poke or another emulator)
win_status.none: no detector: the episode ends only on game over or the stall limit

games.title: Castlevania
games.start: fresh standard 1-player game, first controllable frame (boot)

progress.units: 32 per new (32 px column, floor) cell visited in the stage, + 1500 x boss damage on boss stages
progress.rule: new high-water progress in the current level only

next_level.rule: reaching the next level in order; a skip ends the episode with no bonus

death.when: Simon dies (health 0, time-out, pit or water)

waiting.per: 120 s in play without moving forward

rollback.rule: one abrupt progress drop in valid same-level play, excluding death/transition/win

episode_ends.stall: 120 s of game time without new progress, a new level or a death (penalty -0.1, same as a death)

games.no_reward_when: not in play (title, menus, demo, pause, transitions)
limits: boss bar verified on the stage-3 Phantom Bat only

games.title: Contra

progress.rule: new high-water progress in the current level only

next_level.rule: reaching the next level in order; a skip ends the episode with no bonus

win.when: none (the ending was not reached; after the last stage the game loops)

waiting.per: 120 s in play without moving forward

rollback.rule: one abrupt progress drop in valid same-level play, excluding death/transition/win

episode_ends.stall: 120 s of game time without new progress, a new level or a death (penalty -0.1, same as a death)

games.no_reward_when: not in play (title, menus, demo, pause, transitions)
limits: bosses of stages 2-8 (incl. the last base room) have no damage term: the reward is flat during them
